title: NCAA: Player of the Week Estrada tows Letran to top seed, quarterfinals edge
summary: Jimboy Estrada rose to the occasion as Colegio de San Juan de Letran became the first team to secure a twice-to-beat advantage heading into the quarterfinals of NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball.
